worldcombat.skill.worryseed.summary: Plants a worry seed on the target, leaving it unable to sleep and overriding its Ability with Insomnia until the seed withers.
worldcombat.skill.worryseed.use.0: Replace the target's dangerous Ability with Insomnia
worldcombat.skill.worryseed.use.1: Shut down sleep tactics by keeping the target awake
Tosses the seed within %1$s blocks after a %2$s s wind-up, at about %3$s blocks/tick.
The seed overrides the target's Ability with Insomnia for %1$s s; it cannot fall asleep and any current sleep is cured on the spot.
About %1$s seeds circle during windup; the impact sprouts roots and about %2$s question marks.
worldcombat.skill.worryseed.deep.0: Deep planting: worry lasts ×1.7 and cooldown +20 ticks; one cast locks the target down.
worldcombat.skill.worryseed.deep.1: Shallow planting: worry lasts ×0.6 and cooldown −12 ticks; cheap enough to re-seed often.
worldcombat.skill.worryseed.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.worryseed.growth.0: At level %1$s the committed cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.worryseed.growth.1: At level %1$s the committed cooldown shortens again to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.worryseed.preference.d: On = deep planting: worry ×1.7 and cooldown +20 ticks, one cast locks the target down. Off = shallow planting: worry ×0.6 and cooldown −12 ticks, cheap enough to re-seed often. Duration trades against how often you cast.
worldcombat.skill.worryseed.preference.a: Only consider seeding a threat inside this distance; larger seeds earlier from farther away, smaller only at close range.
On, a holding companion will leave its post to seed a foe; off, it only casts when already in reach.
world_combat.move.worryseed.text.woken: Woken, and can no longer sleep
